content_and_text_rules.em_dash_rule: CRITICAL: Replace all em dashes ('—') with standard hyphens ('-') across all headings, body text, buttons, and subtexts.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Follow the exact section order: Navbar, Hero, About Raj, Services Grid, Why Choose Us, Service Areas, Testimonials, Instagram Feed, Booking CTA, Footer.
2. Strict compliance with the 'no em dashes' rule: Replace '—' with '-' everywhere in copy.
3. Ensure the mobile hero tagline strip is strictly visible above the fold on mobile viewports.
4. Implement all 15 massage service cards with price tags and book buttons.
5. Implement all 7 trust signal cards in 'Why Choose Us'.
6. Include data-testid attributes on all interactive and key informational elements.
